import paramiko
import time
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Check current dist timestamp
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/server/dist/index.js")
print("Dist:", stdout.read().decode())
# Delete dist and rebuild fresh
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("rm -rf /opt/areloria/server/dist && cd /opt/areloria/server && pnpm run build 2>&1 | tail -8")
print("\nBuild:", stdout.read().decode())
# Restart
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 restart areloria && sleep 8")
print("\nRestart:", stdout.read().decode())
# Check ports
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ss -tlnp | grep node")
print("\nPorts:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
EOF
